bazi_desc_pillars: The four pillars stand for year, month, day and hour, and each pairs one Heavenly Stem with one Earthly Branch. The year and month change at the exact moment of a solar term, not on the first day of a lunar month; the day pillar changes at 11 p.m.
bazi_desc_elements: Bars show weighted shares: each Heavenly Stem counts 1.0; each Earthly Branch is split into its hidden stems at 0.6 for the main qi, 0.3 for the middle qi and 0.1 for the residual qi; anything in the month branch is multiplied by 1.5. The number after each bar is the actual count of stems plus branch main qi.
bazi_desc_strength: Supporting elements are Friend and Rob Wealth plus the two Resource stars. If they make up 50% or more of the total score, the Day Master is read as strong; below that, as weak.
bazi_desc_useful: This uses the balancing method: a chart that leans strong is balanced by elements that control, drain or exhaust the Day Master; a chart that leans weak is balanced by elements that produce or support it. The list runs from lowest to highest current score. Schools differ on this, so treat it as a reference only.
bazi_desc_luck: Luck pillars run forward for a man born in a yang year or a woman born in a yin year, and backward for a man born in a yin year or a woman born in a yang year. The starting age comes from the time between your birth and a solar term: the next one for forward pillars, the previous one for backward pillars (three days count as one year). Ages are counted the traditional Chinese way (you are 1 at birth).
bazi_desc_shensha: Each common symbolic star is found by looking up a branch from the day stem, year stem, day branch or year branch. The table also notes which pillar of your chart it appears in.
bazi_desc_weight: Bone weight reading is attributed to Yuan Tiangang: your lunar birth year, month, day and hour each carry a weight in qian, and ten qian make one liang.
bazi_dst_note: 1 hour of daylight saving time removed
bazi_strength_detail: Supporting elements (Friend, Rob Wealth and Resource) score {support} of {total} points, or {percent}%.
bazi_luck_start: Luck pillars begin at {years} years {months} months
bazi_luck_hint: Tap any pillar to see its annual pillars
bazi_luck_approximate: No birth time given: the starting age is estimated from noon on your birth date and may be off by a few days.
bazi_shensha_hour_note: No birth time given, so the hour pillar was not checked for symbolic stars.
bazi_weight_requires_hour: Bone weight needs a birth time. So far: year {year} + month {month} + day {day} qian. Add your birth time to get the total.
bazi_ziwei_requires_hour: Zi Wei Dou Shu uses your birth hour to place the Life Palace and Body Palace, so it needs a time of birth. Enter your birth time, or use the BaZi calculator to see your three known pillars.
bazi_ziwei_desc_palaces: Each palace sits in a fixed Earthly Branch position, with the Life Palace and Body Palace marked. Every palace lists the main stars it holds and their brightness, and the birth-year Four Transformations (Hua Lu, Hua Quan, Hua Ke, Hua Ji) are marked beside the star they affect.
bazi_ziwei_desc_mutagens: The birth-year Four Transformations are set by the Heavenly Stem of your birth year: four stars each take on Hua Lu (wealth), Hua Quan (power), Hua Ke (reputation) or Hua Ji (obstacle).
bazi_ziwei_center: {class} · Life Palace in {soul} · Body Palace in {body}
